propsVocabulary.body: the group's inner area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real addon/input children are the prose-deferred sub-slice)
propsVocabulary.size: group size → one pa-input-group--* modifier (xs|sm|lg|xl) matching the prepend/append height to the input size. svelte `size`, keen `size`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only. The container is always a <div class="pa-input-group ..."> in both wrappers. The body slot is a plain text token so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not addon content. A size modifier is present when a size is set. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-input-group block modifiers are exactly xs/sm/lg/xl. The __prepend/__append/__button elements are per-addon, prose-deferred below.

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; addon structure is the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ADDON element classes of the pa-input-group block — NOT container markup. keen builds them from named slots (:prepend/:append/:button); svelte from raw child markup. The container-only text slot can't carry them, so this is a PROSE deferral (not a verified fixture ref — neither dumper registers an addon fragment). Verified instead in each wrapper's own tests.
deferred.pa-input-group__prepend: inline-start addon — keen :prepend named slot (<span class=pa-input-group__prepend>), svelte raw <span> child
deferred.pa-input-group__append: inline-end addon — keen :append named slot (<span class=pa-input-group__append>), svelte raw <span> child
deferred.pa-input-group__button: button addon — class the author puts on the button so it keeps the group's joined radius; keen :button slot content, svelte raw <button> child
